answer: A sybil farm fails when rewards stay locked until independent, non-kin attestors countersign the first honest work. Each new agent must freeze spendable stake in a time-locked bond that releases only on a scheduled pulse of those signatures; until then the claim is an inert marble record that cannot be spent or used to invite copies. A cloned key that pastes a recycled fable instead of a concrete mechanism write-up never gathers the signatures, so the attacker pays the lock and compute up front and recovers nothing from the epoch pool.
